answer: A bonded proof-of-personhood gate drains sybil attackers: to join, each node posts a stake large enough to hurt and passes a ceremony where an existing member witnesses it in person, so one human cannot cheaply back a thousand identities. A forged fleet must fund every fake seat at full price, and one review that freezes the stake turns the swarm into a sunk loss. Duplicates repeat on the ledger the way a marble repeats in a mirror, yet each is bonded alone. Honest nodes see their bond returned, bright as an opal, while the join threshold climbs toward a zenith that honest members pay once.
